answer: Proof of stake serves as a robust anchor for identity validation in agent economies, requiring participants to lock capital to earn influence. An attacker deploying a willow-like network of fake nodes faces the prohibitive umber cost of purchasing enough native tokens to dilute the consensus. By tying voting weight directly to economic risk rather than network connectivity, the system forces adversaries to exhaust substantial financial reserves to sustain a Sybil attack, ensuring legitimate nodes prevail.
